Funcția opțională de verificare prelucre: The optional check processes information you enter about yourself: your email address or name and, optionally, your location. Datele și rezultatele rapoartelor sunt c: Report data and results are encrypted in the application's database and are accessible only to the session that started the check. The default retention period is 24 hours and can be configured by the operator from 1 to 72 hours; the exact period is shown on the page and in the report. You can delete the report before it expires. Access is blocked immediately on expiry, and physical deletion is performed periodically by the Scheduler. Losing the session cookie means losing access to the report.
Clasificările „Sunt eu”, „Nu sunt eu” și: The classifications “This is me,” “This isn't me” and “I'm not sure” remain in the private report and are not identity checks. Abuse prevention uses HMAC identifiers; administrative statistics contain only daily totals by provider and are retained for 30 days. Deleting a report does not remove data held by providers or from public sources. Backups are deleted according to the operator's retention cycle, not instantly. Before production use, the operator must specify backup retention, providers and any international transfers in this policy.
